fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications announced three new services on the Baladna platform: company commercial registration, electronic accounts for law firms, and remote renewal of lawyers' practising licences.
The Baldna platform of the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications lists trade and import/export services that users apply for through it.
The Baldna government-institutions and trade category lists 24 services, such as import registration, electronic export contracts and exporter-importer register renewals.
The Baldna listing shows request counts per service, including 79,126 for company and business-name import registration and 11,174 for electronic export contracts.
